name: The Lost Report
summary: In Dustwallow Marsh, you uncover a spy's report bound for Brackenwall Village. An orc's severed hand grips a bone tube holding a dirt-stained account of weeks spent watching Theramore.

sections.title: A Hand in the Dirt
sections.body: You find an orc's severed hand in loose dirt, its fingers closed around a tube carved from bone. Inside lies a dirt-stained parchment. It reports on Theramore after weeks of spying and is meant for Nazeer Bloodpike, the orcs' spymaster at Brackenwall Village.

sections.title: Word from the Spymaster
sections.body: Nazeer Bloodpike names Marg Nighteye as the report's author. Marg was an agent stationed outside Theramore to watch the city. This is Marg's latest report, and perhaps the last. From what you tell him, Bloodpike fears Marg met an end in the swamp.

aliases: how to start the lost report
faq.answer: You find the report in loose dirt in Dustwallow Marsh, clutched by a severed orc hand.

aliases: what does the spy report say
faq.answer: An orc wrote the report after spying on Theramore for weeks.

aliases: who do i turn the report in to
faq.answer: The report goes to Nazeer Bloodpike, the orcs' spymaster at Brackenwall Village.
